benefits.subtitle: The four things buyers ask about most, answered by the slippers themselves.
benefits.empukNyaman: Thick foam that softens every step, comfortable from morning to night.
benefits.antiSlip: A textured sole that keeps your footing sure on slippery tiled floors.
benefits.designLucu: A gemoy design that makes staying home nicer and still looks good on.

steps.title: Four steps, no account needed
steps.subtitle: From choosing a quantity to the parcel in your hands — all from one page.

s1.title: Choose a quantity
s1.body: Open the product page, pick how many pairs you want, then press Buy Now.

s2.title: Fill in your address
s2.body: Enter your name, phone/WhatsApp number and full delivery address.

s3.title: Choose how to pay
s3.body: Pay online through Midtrans, or cash on delivery where it is available for your province.

s4.title: Keep your order number
s4.body: Your order number and phone number are what let you check the status at any time.

paymentDelivery.title: How payment and delivery work
paymentDelivery.codAll: Cash on delivery (COD) is available in every province.
paymentDelivery.codExcept: Cash on delivery (COD) is available, except for addresses in {provinces}.
paymentDelivery.codFree: COD is free, with no extra fee.
paymentDelivery.shipping: Shipping is calculated from the destination province and shown before you pay.

faq.title: What buyers ask most
faq.subtitle: Still unanswered? The full guide lives on the How to Order page.

cod.q: Can I pay cash on delivery (COD)?
cod.a: Yes, for the provinces where we offer it, and it is free with no extra fee. As you fill in your address, the COD option appears by itself when it is available there. Where it is not available, you can still order with an online payment.

ongkir.a: Shipping is calculated from the destination province and the number of pairs you order, then shown in the order summary before you press Place Order. Nothing extra is added after the order is made.

ukuran.a: Gemoy Slippers are made in one size for all, so there is no number to choose when you order.

pengembalian.q: What if the item is not what I expected?
pengembalian.a: Items that arrive damaged, faulty or not as ordered can be submitted for a return up to 7 days after you receive the order. Contact us with your order number and photos of the item, and wait for our confirmation before sending anything back.

lacak.q: How do I track my order?
lacak.a: Open the Check Order page and enter your order number together with the phone number you used when ordering. Payment status, delivery status and the tracking number all appear there.

akun.q: Do I need to create an account first?
akun.a: No. Orders are placed straight from the product page, and your order number together with your phone number takes the place of an account for checking or cancelling an order.

metadata.title: How to Order | Tokoshopee
metadata.description: A guide to ordering Gemoy Slippers from Tokoshopee: choose a quantity, enter your shipping address, pick Cash on Delivery or online payment, then await delivery.

howToOrder.title: How to Order
howToOrder.intro: Order straight from the product page. You do not need to create an account.

steps.heading: Ordering Steps
steps.s1: Choose a quantity on the product page, then press Buy Now.
steps.s2: Fill in your name, phone/WhatsApp number and full delivery address.
steps.s3: Choose a payment method: pay online, or cash on delivery (COD) where it is available for your province.
steps.s4: Check the order summary — item price and shipping — then place the order.
steps.s5: Save your order number. The order number and your phone number are what you need to check the order's status.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.online: Online payments are processed through Midtrans. You pay using any method offered on the Midtrans payment page.
payment.cod: Cash on delivery (COD) means you pay the courier when the order arrives. COD is free with no extra fee, but it is not available in every province.
payment.expiry: An online order that is not paid expires automatically, and the stock held for it is released.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.body: Shipping is calculated from the destination province and the quantity ordered, and is always shown before you complete the order.
delivery.tracking: Once the order has shipped, the tracking number appears on the Check Order page.

metadata.title: Terms & Conditions | Tokoshopee
metadata.description: Read Tokoshopee's terms for shopping: order formation, pricing, shipping costs, free Cash on Delivery, cancellation rules, reviews, and seller liability details.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By placing an order with this store, you agree to the terms below.

orders.heading: Orders
orders.formation: An order is formed when you complete the order form and receive an order number. That order number together with your phone number is the only way to access the order's details.
orders.stock: Orders can only be placed while stock is available. If stock is insufficient, no order is created.
orders.expiry: An online order that is not paid within the payment window expires and is cancelled automatically.

pricing.heading: Prices and Fees
pricing.currency: All prices are shown in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) as whole amounts, with no fractional units.
pricing.shipping: Shipping is calculated from the destination province and the quantity ordered, and is shown before the order is placed.
pricing.cod: Cash on delivery (COD) is free and carries no extra fee.

cancellation.heading: Cancellation
cancellation.body: An unpaid order can be cancelled by you directly from the Check Order page. An order that has been paid or confirmed can only be cancelled by submitting a cancellation request, which the shop owner approves or rejects.

reviews.heading: Reviews
reviews.body: Reviews can only be written by customers whose order is completed, and appear once the shop owner approves them. Reviews the owner enters from sales made outside this site are marked as owner-entered.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: We are responsible for delivering goods that match the product description. We are not responsible for delays caused by the courier, or for an incorrect delivery address you supplied.

changes.heading: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: These terms may change over time. The terms that apply to your order are the ones shown on this page when you placed it.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy | Tokoshopee
metadata.description: Learn how Tokoshopee collects, uses, shares, and retains your personal data when you shop with us, including the rights you hold over that data as a customer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data we collect when you order, what it is used for, and how long we keep it.

collected.heading: What We Collect
collected.contact: Your name, phone/WhatsApp number, and email address if you provide one.
collected.address: Your delivery address: province, city/regency, district, postal code and street address.
collected.order: Order details: quantity, price, shipping, payment method, any note you write, order status and tracking number.
collected.payment: For online payments, the payment status we receive from Midtrans. We never receive or store your card details.
collected.review: If you write a review: the reviewer name, rating and comment.
collected.technical: The IP address of your request, used only to limit how many attempts can be made against the order lookup, review and admin sign-in forms.
collected.noAccount: This store has no customer accounts, so no customer passwords are stored.

purpose.heading: How We Use It
purpose.body: Your data is used to process, ship and follow up your order, and to show the order's status when you enter your order number and phone number.
purpose.noMarketing: We do not send marketing email and we do not profile customers.

sharing.heading: Who We Share It With
sharing.payment: The order data needed to take payment is shared with Midtrans, our payment provider.
sharing.courier: Your name, phone number and delivery address are shared with the courier so the order can be delivered.
sharing.noSale: We do not sell or rent your data to anyone.

retention.heading: How Long We Keep It
retention.orders: Order data is kept for as long as it is needed for bookkeeping and for handling returns.
retention.reviews: Approved reviews stay on the product page until the shop owner deletes them.
retention.technical: Rate-limiting records are kept briefly and are discarded once the limiting window has passed.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.body: You can request a copy of, a correction to, or the deletion of your personal data by contacting us at <email></email>. Deletion does not extend to data we are required to keep for bookkeeping.

metadata.title: Returns Policy | Tokoshopee
metadata.description: Learn the 7-day window, eligibility rules, and process for returning or cancelling a Gemoy Slippers order, including the refund process for online payments.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.intro: This page explains when an order can be returned and how money is refunded.

window.heading: Return Window
window.body: We accept return requests up to 7 days after you receive the order.

eligibility.heading: What Can Be Returned
eligibility.e1: Items that are unused and in the condition and packaging in which they arrived.
eligibility.e2: Items that arrived damaged, defective, or not matching what was ordered.
eligibility.e3: Orders for which you can provide the order number and the phone number used to place it.

how.heading: How to Request a Return
how.s1: Contact us at <email></email> with your order number and photographs of the item.
how.s2: Wait for our confirmation before sending anything back.
how.s3: Send the item to the address we give you in that confirmation.

refunds.heading: Refunds
refunds.manual: Refunds for online payments are processed manually by the shop owner and are not automated. This store performs no automatic refund through the payment system: the owner transfers the money themselves and records a refund reference against your order.
refunds.cod: For a COD order cancelled before delivery there is nothing to refund, because payment only happens when the item arrives.
refunds.timing: We will tell you once a refund has been sent. How long it takes to reach your account depends on your bank or payment provider.

cancellation.heading: Cancelling an Order
cancellation.body: An unpaid order can be cancelled by you directly from the Check Order page. An order that has been paid or confirmed needs a cancellation request that the shop owner approves.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions about returns can be sent to <email></email>.
